description: Open Data Philippines is a data repository run by Department of Information and Communications Technology, Philippines. The national portal lists open data sets from Philippine agencies, including transport, energy, water and disaster-related tables and spatial data, with links to agency sources. Coverage: Philippines. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, xlsx; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account.
